provenance_note: Transcribed from circulation-measure-ruwe.py (tick 21, 2026-08-01), whose result is landed in circulation-measure-ruwe.csv. The comment in that script about the two Lindegren documents being one character apart in most bibliographies is the reason `cite_lindegren` and `cite_tn` are separate flags, and the reason every load-bearing hit is hand-read.
